title: FitSquad reservation and payment flow definition
description: Define the Phase 1 reservation and payment flow with one clear choice at booking time: deposit or full payment. The system must support reservation creation, payment status tracking, email confirmations, and manual follow-up for any remaining payment. Do not introduce payment schedules, reminders, user accounts, or complex multi-step booking logic.
acceptance_criteria: define the reservation flow from form submission to payment outcome
define how deposit and full-payment choices are represented and tracked
define when reservation confirmation and payment confirmation emails are sent
identify the high-risk edge cases that Phase 1 still needs to handle simply
